 At Lasclay, September also means excitement, with our Annual Fall Presale of Milkweed Products , where we unveil our new products and offer you the best discounts of the year .

 We’re excited to announce that our 2025 Fall Annual Presale will launch on Saturday, September 13 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time , on our online shop at lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_0). During this Presale, discounts of up to 20% on all products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_1) , with no minimum purchase required, will be available for a very limited time!

 This is the perfect time to get a head start on original, local, and eco-friendly holiday gifts made with milkweed—or to get your family ready for the cold season. 

 

 How the discounts work 
In previous years, we offered a limited quantity of 12%, 15%, and 20% discounts, on a first-come, first-served basis. This year, we’ve decided to adopt a fairer, less stressful approach:

 

 
 
 20% discount for the first 60 minutes, from 9:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. EST on September 13 , with code LASCLAY20

 

 15% discount for the rest of the day on September 13, until 11:59 p.m. , with code LASCLAY15 

 
 12% discount on Sunday, September 14 , until 11:59 p.m. , with code LASCLAY12 

 

 

 The codes must be entered on the checkout page, as shown in the image below:

 Urban mittens 

 Super warm and versatile, available in 5 colors! From $49 to $62, depending on the discount applied.

 Our famous neck warmers, now adjustable 
Now adjustable and available in 4 new colors. Our milkweed scarves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_4) and neck warmers (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_5) have already earned their reputation. Succesfully tested in the Arctic at temperatures as low as -67°F (55°C), they keep you warm and never get damp from breath condensation—a rare quality!

 

 To see them, click here (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_6)

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_7
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Milkweed coats and sleeveless jackets 
Without a doubt, our most requested product of recent years. The Fall Annual Presale will be the last chance to grab them at a discount for this winter!

 

 To see them, click HERE (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_8)

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K4FN8V17HHMS8PEEM0RPWAFT_9
